title: Kasugayama Castle

groundCutout.basis: Replaces terrain only inside the central ridge outline with the preserved one-metre GSI landform.

terrainReference.basis: Original GSI DEM1A grade at the center of the preserved summit enclosure.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap native site controls and GSI DEM1A

identities.name: Kasugayama Castle
identities.address: Kasugayama National Historic Site, Joetsu, Niigata Prefecture, Japan

mapIdentity.scope: Unchanged national one-metre elevation data supply the measured scarp and terrace heights. Named OpenStreetMap ways and nodes fix the enclosure, paths, well edge and markers.

note: Joetsu City identifies an earth castle with many excavated hilltop terraces. An exact Qualla photograph documents the surviving summit marker, roofed noticeboard, pine backdrop and compacted earthen platform.
